title: Buying Time & Steering the Talk
goal: Use spoken hesitation formulas, excuses and steering expressions to manage live conversation
grammar: a ver, es que, no es que + subjunctive / es que + indicative, and steering expressions

items: I can buy time with *a ver* and soften excuses with *es que* and *No es que* + subjunctive, *es que* + indicative.
I can steer a conversation back on track with *ir al grano*, *sin rodeos*, *salirse del tema* and *volver al tema*.
I can recognise and introduce a brief aside (*el inciso*) without losing the main thread.
